data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Firebase Cloud Messaging to deliver messages on Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to reliably receive and handle cross-platform push notifications and cloud messages using the Firebase Cloud Messaging API. It supports background message delivery, handling notification taps, and FID registration APIs.
use_when: You need reliable push notification delivery across Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
Your application backend is already integrated with Firebase.
avoid_when: You do not use Firebase services in your application stack.
You only require purely local notifications without backend push support.
strengths: Official, well-maintained Firebase plugin with Flutter Favorite status.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and Firebase setup.
Breaking changes can occur with major version bumps of Firebase SDKs.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase in your project, adding platform-specific setup (like iOS UNUserNotificationCenter delegate and APNs registration), and setting the minimum Android SDK version to 24.
